key_highlights: ASX slides as oil prices rise; big four banks, tech and mining stocks fall, though energy and miners rally intraday (#20, #52)
Iron ore under severe pressure – 'drowning' narrative weighs on BHP, RIO, FMG (#25, #53)
Hormuz Strait escalation lifts oil, supporting Santos, Woodside, Origin (#28, #30)
Gold mining sector active: Forrestania hits 2Moz, Manhattan hits high-grade gold, Aureka acquires Victorian mine (#39, #41, #45)
Property sector faces 'GFC moment'; RBA unlikely to intervene (#36, #63)
Qantas $35M payout to fired workers signals ongoing operational stress (#4)
Lion rejects Saint takeover bid – WES competitive dynamics shift (#3)
Living standards collapse masked by public sector boom; mortgage costs push Aussies into second jobs (#31, #51)

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP under existential pressure. Gold miners active with multiple discoveries. Uranium exploration (Infini) positive.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NLA.AX, FOR.AX) and uranium (INL.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from iron ore concentration.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation and gas cartel break lift oil/gas prices. Santos under pressure but sector benefits from higher commodity prices.
sectors.implications: STO.AX, WDS.AX, ORG.AX benefit from oil upside. Gas cartel break may increase supply, capping LNG margins medium-term.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall on risk-off sentiment. Property stress and RBA inaction raise NIM and credit risk concerns.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face headwinds from property sector deterioration. Super policy debate adds regulatory uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Lion rejects Saint bid; WES competitive landscape shifts. Living standards squeeze pressures discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX faces margin pressure from Saint competition. Defensive staples (WOW.AX, WPG.AX) may outperform.

sectors.trend: Property industry faces 'GFC moment'; builders collapsing despite housing shortage. RBA unlikely to cut to support sector.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) and builders (MPL.AX, WBC.AX construction) under pressure. Credit risk to banks elevated.

sectors.trend: Healthcare barriers (waitlists, bulk billing) create policy risk. Tech stocks fall with ASX broadly. Global AI/security names (Okta +20%) show divergence.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX face policy headwinds. ASX tech lags global AI rally; limited local exposure.

Geopolitical risk (Hormuz, Trump, Germany far-right) driving oil and gold
Property sector stress with no RBA rescue in sight
Living standards deterioration masked by public sector employment
Gold mining sector in discovery/consolidation phase
Super policy and pensioner workforce debate creating regulatory uncertainty
Qantas operational and labour cost pressures

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and energy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Hormuz Strait escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities (STO.AX, WDS.AX) and inflation-linked assets
Underweight REITs and construction; monitor bank NIM and credit losses

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy inaction amid living standards decline
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour dividend-paying defensives; avoid rate-sensitive growth

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global geopolitical / US political risk (Trump, Germany)
Qantas / aviation sector labour and cost pressures
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor QAN.AX cost base; limited ASX index impact

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on discovery cycle and safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Manhattan, Larvotto) plus Trump/geopolitical risk support gold

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on Hormuz-driven oil upside
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz escalation and gas cartel break lift oil/gas prices; Santos, Woodside benefit

opportunities.recommendation: Uranium exploration play on Infini's 7.5% source discovery
opportunities.rationale: High-grade uranium discovery in Canada supports ASX-listed uranium names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP 'mulls suicide' signals severe margin pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property and construction; avoid REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Property 'GFC moment' with no RBA rescue; builders collapsing despite shortage

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hold quality dividend defensives in banks and staples
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA inaction and living standards squeeze favour income over growth

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from iron ore weakness and property stress. Energy stocks provide partial offset on oil. Hormuz escalation adds volatility. CPI data this week is key catalyst. Expect range-bound to slightly lower ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift away from iron ore toward gold, energy, and uranium. Property sector may see further corrections. RBA constrained by fiscal pressures. Living standards decline could force policy response later in 2026. Gold and energy are the primary ASX growth vectors.

RBA rate decision and property policy stance (#63)
Super and pensioner workforce policy changes (#26, #47)
US midterms impact on global risk appetite (#56)

CPI, retail sales, housing starts data
GOLD.AX, NLA.AX on gold discovery cycle
CBA.AX, NAB.AX credit and NIM trends
